ma.getSavedFileInfo(Object object)

Obtain the local file information. This API can only be used to obtain files that have been saved to the local PC. To obtain information about temporary files, use the ma.getFileInfo() API.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
filePath String Yes Local file path.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
object.success Callback Function
Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getSavedFileInfo: ok
size Number File size, in byte.
createTime Number Timestamp when a file is saved, which is the number of seconds from 1970/01/01 08:00:00 to the time when the file is saved.

Sample Code

ma.getSavedFileInfo({
  filePath: 'filePath',
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.size);
    console.log(res.createTime);
  }
});

Tips

  1. Support calling through FileSystemManager
